title: 8:7 waters of the river. The river spoken of here is the great Euphrates that flowed through Assyria, but Isaiah uses the river as a metaphor for the "king of Assyria" (8:7) and his armies. Other prophets have similarly likened armies to great rivers and floods that "cover the earth" and "destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof" (Jer. 46:8; 47:2; Amos 8:8; Dan. 9:26), just as Noah warned his contemporaries of the worldwide flood that would destroy all creatures save those who found salvation on the ark (Gen. 6:5-17).
author: Tina M. Peterson
